message.content:
Here’s a quick list of well‑known documentaries (and one newer series) that focus on climate change / global warming:

| Title | Release year | Synopsis |
|-------|--------------|----------|
| **“An Inconvenient Truth”** | 2006 | Former Vice President Al Gore presents an accessible overview of climate science, evidence of rising temperatures, sea‑level rise, and policy options—often considered the film that sparked mainstream conversation around global warming. |
| **“An Inconvenient Sequel: Truth to Power”** | 2017 | A follow‑up to the original, this film examines progress since 2006, highlights new data, and calls for urgent action while showcasing how individual choices matter. |
| **“Climate Change – The Facts”** | 2019 | An animated short produced by the BBC that explains key concepts behind greenhouse gases, temperature trends, and mitigation strategies in under ten minutes. |
| **“Our Planet” (Season 1)** | 2019 | While primarily focused on biodiversity, each episode includes segments on how climate change threatens ecosystems worldwide. Narrated by Sir David Attenborough. |
| **“Before the Flood”** | 2015 | Leonardo DiCaprio travels globally to meet scientists, activists, and policymakers, illustrating the human impact of climate change and exploring solutions. |
| **“A Plastic Ocean”** | 2016 | Though centered on plastic pollution, it also covers ocean acidification—a direct consequence of increased CO₂—and shows how marine life suffers from warming waters. |
| **“Ice Fall”** | 2020 | This National Geographic feature follows glacial melt across several continents, providing visual proof of rapid ice loss linked to higher atmospheric temperatures. |
| **“Heat Death of the World”** | 2022 | A more speculative look at future scenarios if current emissions continue unchecked, blending expert interviews with dramatic visuals. |

### Where to Watch

| Platform | Availability |
|-----------|---------------|
| Netflix | “An Inconvenient Truth”, “Before the Flood”, “Our Planet” |
| Amazon Prime Video | “An Inconvenible Sequel”, “Heat Death of the World” |
| Disney+ | “Our Planet” (season 1 & 2) |
| YouTube Movies/TV | “Climate Change – The Facts”, “I’m Not Alone” (shorts) |
| PBS Digital Library | “An Inconvenient Truth” (free download) |
| Apple TV+ | “Earth Unplugged” (related content) |

If you’re looking for something very recent or regionally tailored, let me know your location or preferred platform, and I’ll dig up additional recommendations!
